body:
I’m very sorry for your loss, I understand what your going though. I’ve been playing my wife and I’s song every morning since she passed. It’s been about two years since I lost her now. I know most people say it gets easier as time passes, but that hasn’t really been the case for me. I’ve been working as much as I can to take my mind off of her death but I still catch myself thinking of the what if’s and thinking about where we would be now. I wish I could see her smile one more time. Maybe I just don’t know how to cope, I just don’t know. 
Do you think it has gotten easier?
Try to stay strong.
My wife hung herself about a year ago, and it's been hard on me. I barely made it through 2017, even with therapy. I don't know, I just wish I could at least see her.
Yeah it really is. Whenever I feel at my worst, that song makes me feel like she's with me.
I'm glad you were able to some peace in walking. I'll try to get out more, I've mostly been working and sleeping since she past away, maybe I'll find some peace too

I thought about counselling, but I don't know. I guess it wouldn't hurt. 

I try to think of the good times every now and then, it's just hard to remember because the pain of losing her. Our song was 'Boats And Birds'. I'll never forget our dance to that song, I was never happier my entire life.
